resolved_points.point: N-BaIoT MI_dir_* (15 features) not defined on the UCI page
resolved_points.resolution: RESOLVED as derived evidence 2026-09-04: Meidan et al. 2018 Table 2 and the 'Feature extraction' section define 23 features per time scale over four aggregation objects (Source IP, Source MAC-IP, Channel, Socket). Matching the frozen 115-column header by group width: H=3 (Source IP), HH=7 (Channel), HH_jit=3 (Channel jitter), HpHp=7 (Socket), leaving MI_dir=3 (Source MAC-IP). Therefore MI_dir_* are damped-window statistics aggregated by Source MAC-IP: weight = damped count, mean/variance = mean and variance of outbound-only packet sizes. The paper never uses the literal string 'MI_dir', so the prefix attribution is by elimination, not verbatim definition.
